scripts.translation:
[武术宗师]
恭喜。
向战士们致敬！

[武术宗师]
技巧。
速度。
力量。
敏捷。

scripts.text:
[Champion]
A Champion can
benefit from all
these things. But
one can only master
so much in life...
scripts.translation:
[武术宗师]
武术宗师可以从
所有这些方面受益。
但人一生能精通的
终究有限……

scripts.text:
[Champion]
It's time.
Time for great heroes
to stand up against the
forces of evil which plague
the world of Midgard!
scripts.translation:
[武术宗师]
时机已到。
伟大的英雄们该站出来，
对抗肆虐米德加尔特世界的
邪恶势力了！

scripts.text:
[Champion]
Would you like
to become a Champion?
scripts.translation:
[武术宗师]
你想成为
武术宗师吗？

scripts.text:
[Champion]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[武术宗师]
等你准备好了，
随时可以回来。
向战士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Champion]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[武术宗师]
你仍然可以学习更多技能。请在回到我这里之前，
用完所有剩余的技能点数。

scripts.text:
[Champion]
Congratulations!
Live as a Champion,
and bring light into
the world through the
strength of your fists.
scripts.translation:
[武术宗师]
恭喜！
以武术宗师的身份生活，
用你拳头的力量
为世界带来光明。

scripts.text:
[Champion]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[武术宗师]
欢迎来到
瓦尔哈拉，
荣誉殿堂。

scripts.text:
[Champion]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[武术宗师]
请在此处
随意放松。
向战士们致敬！
